offering_description.value: Designs, installs and maintains mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems for commercial, institutional and healthcare buildings. Sells to general contractors, building owners and developers, mostly through construction contracts and recurring service agreements.

primary_services.value: mechanical installation; electrical installation; plumbing installation; design-build; service and maintenance

customer_segment.value: B2B: general contractors, commercial building owners, developers, data center operators; B2G: public schools, universities, government agencies

end_markets.value: healthcare; education; data centers; commercial real estate; multifamily residential; industrial

revenue_model.value: project or contract: construction contracts for installing building systems; service fees: recurring maintenance and repair agreements for building systems

value_chain_position.value: service provider: installs and maintains building systems, sold to contractors and building owners

geography_served.value: US national: Multiple regions across eastern, central and western United States through regional offices

specialization.value: related lines: mechanical, electrical and plumbing contracting, plus service and maintenance for building systems

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: bids and negotiated contracts with owners and general contractors; own locations: regional branch offices and service centers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: contractor licensing, building codes, OSHA safety and EPA refrigerant rules
